      IKNC-AI Vision
      IKNC-AI is an operational module within the core system that translates business requirements into direct implementation by bridging DB structures with functional logic. It enables implementers to not only query complex knowledge using natural language but to execute configurations and scripts within a controlled, automated environment. By 2026, the module will serve as a full "Execution Pilot," transforming manual technical tasks into supervised, AI-driven actions that ensure maximum accuracy and efficiency
